P23-lowest-common-ancestor-of-a-binary-t:
def lowest_common_ancestor(root, p, q):
    parent, stack = {root: None}, [root]
    while p not in parent or q not in parent:   # map nodes to parents until both are seen
        node = stack.pop()
        for child in (node.left, node.right):
            if child:
                parent[child] = node
                stack.append(child)
    ancestors = set()
    while p:
        ancestors.add(p)
        p = parent[p]
    while q not in ancestors:          # first ancestor of q that p shares
        q = parent[q]
    return q
